popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus names Niobe daughter of Phoroneus as the first mortal woman Zeus lies with — mother of Argus, eponym of Argos. Carefully distinct from Niobe daughter of Tantalus.

popCulture.title: Niobe (Argive)
popCulture.description: Daughter of Phoroneus, first mortal beloved of Zeus, mother of Argus — the Argive Niobe, not the Theban weeper of the Niobids.

popCulture.title: Phoroneus
popCulture.description: Niobe's father — primeval king of Argos whose daughter links the Inachid house to Zeus and the naming of the land.

popCulture.title: Argus (king of Argos)
popCulture.description: Niobe's son by Zeus — the king who gives his name to Argos and the Argives.
